text: The filter dialog change uses a background image for its dropmarker and a separate 22px size. Current CSS keeps inline-size, centered non-repeating background artwork and currentColor stroke, while runFiltersFolder clips overflow. For this compound control, preserve the artwork and sizing roles separately. The historical dialog-shadow stylesheet additions serve the native dialog button styling; no rendered sizing, keyboard or contrast check was run. This is static source and test-code inspection. Full Bugzilla and review timeline and inline discussion remains pending. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility validation ran.
title: Keep filter dropmarker artwork separate from its layout box
